commit ead2252b2b717f52728a6b8c78a2e9346863ccb8
Author: Yifeng Sun <pkusunyifeng@gmail.com>
Date:   Thu Oct 25 16:17:23 2018 -0700

    ofctl_parse_target: Only parse complete ofputil_flow_mod data.

    When parse_ofp_flow_mod_str returns error, `fm` is incomplete and pointers
    in it may be null, e.g. fm.match.flow. In this case, passing it to
    ofctl_parse_flows__ may cause pointer errors because ofctl_parse_flows__
    expects a valid input of type struct ofputil_flow_mod.

    Reported-at: https://bugs.chromium.org/p/oss-fuzz/issues/detail?id=11110
    Signed-off-by: Yifeng Sun <pkusunyifeng@gmail.com>
    Signed-off-by: Ben Pfaff <blp@ovn.org>
---
 tests/oss-fuzz/ofctl_parse_target.c | 3 ++-
 1 file changed, 2 insertions(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/tests/oss-fuzz/ofctl_parse_target.c b/tests/oss-fuzz/ofctl_parse_target.c
index 29f89f9b5..13d0899db 100644
--- a/tests/oss-fuzz/ofctl_parse_target.c
+++ b/tests/oss-fuzz/ofctl_parse_target.c
@@ -58,8 +58,9 @@ ofctl_parse_flow(const char *input, int command)
                                    command, &usable_protocols);
     if (error) {
         printf("Error encountered: %s\n", error);
+    } else {
+        ofctl_parse_flows__(&fm, 1, usable_protocols);
     }
-    ofctl_parse_flows__(&fm, 1, usable_protocols);
 }

commit e29744123207be23c12d942cd3ea8ba11c5d3c0e
Author: Yifeng Sun <pkusunyifeng@gmail.com>
Date:   Wed Nov 7 12:42:16 2018 -0800

    ofctl_parse_target: Avoid passing invalid ofputil_protocol to ofputil_protocol_to_ofp_version

    In this test, the involved ovs functions expect valid ofputil_protocol
    values. Therefore, if usable_protocols is invalid, we should return.
    Otherwise, ovs will abort.

    Reported-at: https://bugs.chromium.org/p/oss-fuzz/issues/detail?id=11165
    Signed-off-by: Yifeng Sun <pkusunyifeng@gmail.com>
    Signed-off-by: Ben Pfaff <blp@ovn.org>
---
 tests/oss-fuzz/ofctl_parse_target.c | 1 +
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+)

diff --git a/tests/oss-fuzz/ofctl_parse_target.c b/tests/oss-fuzz/ofctl_parse_target.c
index fbd91bdd3..db86c7da1 100644
--- a/tests/oss-fuzz/ofctl_parse_target.c
+++ b/tests/oss-fuzz/ofctl_parse_target.c
@@ -22,6 +22,7 @@ ofctl_parse_flows__(struct ofputil_flow_mod *fms, size_t n_fms,

     if (!(usable_protocols & OFPUTIL_P_ANY)) {
         printf("no usable protocol\n");
+        return;
     }
     for (i = 0; i < sizeof(enum ofputil_protocol) * CHAR_BIT; i++) {
         protocol = 1u << i;
commit 9b3683ec8293cf03d8750671440afa950bbad718
Author: Yifeng Sun <pkusunyifeng@gmail.com>
Date:   Thu Nov 1 11:39:59 2018 -0700

    oss-fuzz: Free error string in ofctl_parse_flow

    This patch frees the leaked error string to stop oss-fuzz from
    complaining.

    Reported-at: https://bugs.chromium.org/p/oss-fuzz/issues/detail?id=11161
    Signed-off-by: Yifeng Sun <pkusunyifeng@gmail.com>
    Signed-off-by: Ben Pfaff <blp@ovn.org>
---
 tests/oss-fuzz/ofctl_parse_target.c | 1 +
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+)

diff --git a/tests/oss-fuzz/ofctl_parse_target.c b/tests/oss-fuzz/ofctl_parse_target.c
index 4c5925d27..fbd91bdd3 100644
--- a/tests/oss-fuzz/ofctl_parse_target.c
+++ b/tests/oss-fuzz/ofctl_parse_target.c
@@ -58,6 +58,7 @@ ofctl_parse_flow(const char *input, int command)
                                    command, &usable_protocols);
     if (error) {
         printf("Error encountered: %s\n", error);
+        free(error);
     } else {
         ofctl_parse_flows__(&fm, 1, usable_protocols);
     }
